Load packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Shared setup

`prepare_gwas()` reads one GAPIT output file and does all the cleaning / cumulative-position math, and flags which SNPs are genome-wide significant (`sig`).

`make_manhattan()` builds a single Manhattan panel using plain `geom_point()` (fully vector, so it stays crisp in PDF). Significant SNPs are drawn bigger, and optionally labelled with a QTL name you type in yourself -- you pick which SNP by its `id` number from `list_significant()`'s printed table, so there's no chromosome-naming or position guessing involved.

```{r}
sig_threshold <- 5e-8
y_axis_cap    <- 5e-16   # controls plotted ylim, same as before

prepare_gwas <- function(file, chr_labels) {
  gwas <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Replace zero p-values
  gwas$P.value[gwas$P.value == 0] <- 1e-300

  # Remove missing values
  gwas <- na.omit(gwas)

  # Convert variables
  gwas$Chr  <- factor(gwas$Chr)
  gwas$Pos  <- as.numeric(gwas$Pos)
  gwas$logP <- -log10(gwas$P.value)
  gwas$sig  <- gwas$P.value < sig_threshold

  # Compute cumulative chromosome positions
  chr_sizes <- gwas %>%
    group_by(Chr) %>%
    summarise(chr_len = max(Pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(chr_len), default = 0))

  gwas <- left_join(gwas, chr_sizes, by = "Chr")
  gwas$BPcum <- gwas$Pos + gwas$offset

  # Chromosome centers, for axis labels
  axisdf <- gwas %>%
    group_by(Chr) %>%
    summarise(center = (min(BPcum) + max(BPcum)) / 2, .groups = "drop")
  axisdf$label <- chr_labels

  list(data = gwas, axis = axisdf)
}

# Prints the significant SNPs, each with a simple sequential ID, plus its
# raw Chr value, friendly axis label, position, and -log10(P). Use the ID
# number (not Chr/Pos) to tell make_manhattan() which SNP gets which QTL
# name -- this can't be thrown off by chromosome-naming mismatches.
list_significant <- function(prepped) {
  sig <- subset(prepped$data, sig)
  sig <- sig[order(sig$Chr, sig$Pos), ]
  sig <- dplyr::left_join(sig, prepped$axis[, c("Chr", "label")], by = "Chr")
  names(sig)[names(sig) == "label"] <- "axis_label"
  sig$id <- seq_len(nrow(sig))
  sig[, c("id", "Chr", "axis_label", "Pos", "logP")]
}

# qtl_labels is a small data frame you type by hand:
#   id    = the ID number from list_significant()'s printed table
#   Label = the QTL name you want printed next to that SNP
make_manhattan <- function(prepped, qtl_labels = NULL, show_x_labels = TRUE) {
  gwas   <- prepped$data
  axisdf <- prepped$axis

  gwas$qtl_label <- NA_character_

  if (!is.null(qtl_labels) && nrow(qtl_labels) > 0) {
    # rebuild the exact same sorted significant-SNP table that
    # list_significant() shows, so the id numbers line up
    sig_table <- subset(gwas, sig)
    sig_table <- sig_table[order(sig_table$Chr, sig_table$Pos), ]
    sig_table$id <- seq_len(nrow(sig_table))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(qtl_labels))) {
      id_i  <- qtl_labels$id[i]
      lab_i <- qtl_labels$Label[i]

      match_row <- sig_table[sig_table$id == id_i, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(match_row) == 0) {
        warning(sprintf(
          "No significant SNP with id %s for label '%s' -- skipped (check list_significant() output).",
          id_i, lab_i
        ))
        next
      }

      target <- which(gwas$Chr == match_row$Chr[1] & gwas$Pos == match_row$Pos[1])
      if (length(target) >= 1) {
        gwas$qtl_label[target[1]] <- lab_i
      }
    }
  }

  label_points <- subset(gwas, !is.na(qtl_label))

  p <- ggplot(gwas, aes(x = BPcum, y = logP)) +
    # background: non-significant SNPs, alternating grey / dark red by chromosome
    geom_point(
      data = subset(gwas, !sig),
      aes(colour = factor(as.numeric(Chr) %% 2)),
      size = 0.6,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    # foreground: significant SNPs, drawn bigger and in solid red so they pop out
    geom_point(
      data = subset(gwas, sig),
      colour = "darkred",
      size = 1.8
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "darkred")) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(sig_threshold),
      colour = "grey50",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axisdf$center,
      labels = axisdf$label
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, -log10(y_axis_cap))) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(-log[10](italic(P)))
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border    = element_blank(),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x     = if (show_x_labels) element_text(size = 11) else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = if (show_x_labels) element_line() else element_blank()
    )

  # only add the QTL-name layer if at least one label was actually matched
  if (nrow(label_points) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text_repel(
      data                = label_points,
      aes(label = qtl_label),
      size                = 3,
      fontface            = "italic",
      colour              = "black",
      nudge_y             = 1,
      min.segment.length  = Inf   # never draw a connecting line back to the point
    )
  }

  p
}

chr_labels_7 <- c("chr1S", "chr1L", "chr2", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr6")
```

## BLINK composite (pisum on top = A, fabae below = B)

First load the data, then check which SNPs are significant -- each row gets an `id` number:

```{r}
pisum_blink <- prepare_gwas(
  "../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/output_gapit/Apisum/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.BLINK.emmean(Kansas).csv",
  chr_labels_7
)

fabae_blink <- prepare_gwas(
  "../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/output_gapit/Afabae/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.BLINK.emmean(Kansas).csv",
  chr_labels_7
)

list_significant(pisum_blink)
list_significant(fabae_blink)
```

Now type in the `id` of whichever significant SNP you want labelled, next to the QTL name. Leave a table with 0 rows (e.g. `data.frame(id = numeric(), Label = character())`) to skip labelling that panel entirely.

```{r}
pisum_blink_labels <- data.frame(
  id    = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  Label = c("APRIS", "APRII.1", "APRII.2", "APRII.3"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fabae_blink_labels <- data.frame(
  id    = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  Label = c("AFRIL", "AFRIII", "AFRV", "AFRVI"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

p_pisum_blink <- make_manhattan(pisum_blink, qtl_labels = pisum_blink_labels, show_x_labels = FALSE)
p_fabae_blink <- make_manhattan(fabae_blink, qtl_labels = fabae_blink_labels, show_x_labels = TRUE)

composite_blink <- (p_pisum_blink / p_fabae_blink) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

print(composite_blink)

ggsave(
  "Manhattan_BLINK_composite.pdf",
  composite_blink,
  width  = 7,
  height = 8
)
```

## MLMM composite (pisum on top = A, fabae below = B)

Note: these two files are the "NYC" MLMM results (matching your original file paths).

```{r}
pisum_mlmm <- prepare_gwas(
  "../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/output_gapit/Apisum/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.MLMM.emmean(NYC).csv",
  chr_labels_7
)

fabae_mlmm <- prepare_gwas(
  "../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/output_gapit/Afabae/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.MLMM.emmean(NYC).csv",
  chr_labels_7
)

list_significant(pisum_mlmm)
list_significant(fabae_mlmm)
```

```{r}
pisum_mlmm_labels <- data.frame(
  id    = c(1, 2, 3),
  Label = c("APRII.1", "APRII.2", "APRII.3"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fabae_mlmm_labels <- data.frame(
  id    = c(1),
  Label = c("AFRIII"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

p_pisum_mlmm <- make_manhattan(pisum_mlmm, qtl_labels = pisum_mlmm_labels, show_x_labels = FALSE)
p_fabae_mlmm <- make_manhattan(fabae_mlmm, qtl_labels = fabae_mlmm_labels, show_x_labels = TRUE)

composite_mlmm <- (p_pisum_mlmm / p_fabae_mlmm) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

print(composite_mlmm)

ggsave(
  "Manhattan_MLMM_composite.pdf",
  composite_mlmm,
  width  = 7,
  height = 8
)
```
